settings.content: Brand palette — keep these to preserve the design

settings.label: Ripe Red (accent)
settings.info: Used as --red. Also referenced in many hand-tuned SVGs/CSS; changing it only affects the CSS variable, not inline SVG fills.

settings.content: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts in the layout

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: Design uses Libre Baskerville for headings.

settings.label: Body font
settings.info: Design uses Outfit for body text (loaded via Google Fonts in the layout).

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.info: Used for the homepage and any page that has no page/product/article description of its own.

settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Used for og:image / Twitter card when a page has no product or article image of its own. Recommended 1200×630px.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Shown in browser tabs and bookmarks. Recommended a square image, at least 32×32px.

settings.label: Publish Product structured data (JSON-LD)
settings.info: Off until the product copy is verified. When on, each product page publishes its title, description, price and availability as machine-readable data for search engines — including anything inaccurate.
